description: NZ.Naturliga riskområden, Skredriskkartering övriga prioriterade älvar.ATOM is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.sgi.se. Skredrisk, probability and consequence maps developed with a slightly simpler methodology than in GÄU Göta ÄlvUtredningen. However, mapping is based on a large amount of digital data. Norsälven (2015) was the first river where this simplified methodology was applied. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "NZ.Natural risk areas, Skredriskkartering other priority rivers.ATOM" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-02-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
